Operator UI derived RUNNING from the CSV header while the audience display stayed disconnected; a separate sounddevice sd.rec probe also stalled.
File-replay sessions 20260909_233546_027169_en and 20260909_233823_034893_es (audio_source=file) completed with exit 0 on the same build; they do not exercise the microphone path.
items.notes: User explicitly deferred live microphone and physical-device checks until tomorrow. The reliability worktree is drafting isolated capture/health helpers; nothing is integrated yet.
